title: Uformer: A General U-Shaped Transformer for Image Restoration
grouping: Three panels in one row, separated by long vertical black dashed rules and labelled (a), (b), (c) centred underneath. (a), the overview, takes about 60% of the width; (b) and (c) are narrow detail panels. In (a) there are no stage containers: grouping is by row (encoder blocks along the top, decoder blocks along the bottom) and by column (each encoder block sits directly above its decoder partner, joined by a vertical skip arrow). The new 'Modulators' are grouped in a labelled dashed rounded box in the bottom-right corner, with an ellipsis for the ones not drawn. (b) puts the block internals inside a grey-filled dashed rounded container. Colour families: projections grey-blue, LeWin blocks pale blue; in (b) LN pale green, W/MW-MSA pale blue, LeFF peach; in (c) the four feature-map quadrant tints are repeated on the four per-window squares.
shapes_depth: Flat rounded rectangles with a moderate corner radius and thin dark outlines; no shadows, gradients or 3-D. Repeat counts are superscripts (xN1 ... xN5) tucked into each block's top-right corner. Down/up-sampling are small circles holding an arrow; additions are circled plus signs. Tensors are not drawn in (a): their sizes are grey math labels (3xHxW, CxHxW, 2CxH/2xW/2, ..., 16CxH/16xW/16) floated above the encoder columns. In (c) the feature map is a flat 2x2 grid of pastel squares, windows are separate flat squares, and the modulator is a small saturated blue square feeding the windows through light-grey multi-line arrows. Input and output images are text labels only, no thumbnails. All connectors are orthogonal black lines with filled arrowheads.
proposed_highlight: Module names are written inside the boxes in plain, non-bold text (LeWin Blocks, W/MW - MSA, LeFF, Modulators). The new modulators are the only saturated fills in the overview (a blue and a cyan square inside the labelled dashed box) and a matching blue square returns as 'Modulator' in (c). The LeWin block is expanded in (b) and the modulated window attention in (c); the tie between (a) and the detail panels is the shared pale-blue block tint, not a callout or connector.
lesson: Fold the U on its side - encoder along the top row, decoder returning along the bottom row, bottleneck dropped at the right end - so input and output share the left edge, every skip is a short vertical arrow, and the freed bottom-right corner holds the new component (a dashed 'Modulators' box) wired into each decoder block from below.
notes: elements 'other' = tensor-size math labels above the encoder columns and the flat 2x2 window grid of the feature map in (c). Flow: (a) runs left-to-right on the top row and right-to-left on the bottom row; (b) and (c) run bottom-to-top.

measured.source: computed: paperfig kb measure (non-white pixels of a <= 800 px thumbnail, white = min(R,G,B) >= 245, minus the embedded images recorded by `refs crop` (images_px; their share is photo_share, null without a record); chromatic (RGB spread > 20) and neutral pixels clustered separately by PIL median-cut + k-means (k=8 / 3); clusters within dE00 4 merged; kept if >= 0.02 of chromatic pixels / neutral ones if >= 0.03 of all non-white pixels; share = fraction of the non-photo non-white pixels)

insights.structure: Three panels in a row separated by black dashed rules and labelled (a)-(c) underneath: (a) the U-shaped overview takes about 60% of the width, (b) the LeWin block internals, (c) how a modulator is added per window.
insights.data: No tensors drawn: shapes like 2C x H/2 x W/2 are light grey-blue text above each encoder column; in (c) a feature map is a 2x2 tinted grid whose quadrant tints repeat on the per-window squares.
insights.emphasis: The new Modulators sit in a labelled dashed box in the bottom-right of (a) as coloured squares, matching the blue Modulator square in (c).
insights.flow: (a) runs left to right along the top encoder row, down to the bottleneck at the right, and back right to left along the bottom decoder row, with vertical skip arrows between partners; (b) and (c) read bottom to top.
insights.avoid: Modulator lines in (a) run back under the whole decoder row to each block, adding long lines that cross the bottom of the panel.

arrangement.units: three unframed panels (a) overview, (b) block detail in a grey dashed container, (c) modulator detail, separated by dashed vertical rules
